required_concepts: shapes (square, rectangle, rhombus, parallelogram, kite, trapezium)
acceptable_paraphrases: Shapes with perpendicular diagonals and rotational symmetry
Shapes that are either square or rectangle
Shapes without perpendicular diagonals and no rotational symmetry
critical_errors: Incorrectly identifying shapes as having perpendicular diagonals when they do not
Incorrectly stating a shape has rotational symmetry when it does not
misconceptions: Thinking all parallelograms are squares or rectangles
Confusing rhombus with square and thinking they always have perpendicular diagonals
Believing that the presence of perpendicular diagonals means a shape has rotational symmetry
Forgetting to include trapezium in answers
grading_notes: Correctly identify at least two properties (diagonals, rotational symmetry) for each shape. Full credit if all shapes and their properties are accurately identified.
